resource_limits: 512 bounds statement entry count, not bytes or RSS. SQL text, VDBE and bindings/internal state may remain resident until reuse/eviction/close.

No candidate speed conclusion follows from authorizer counts or instrumented SQLite execute time. Original whole-matrix performance/resource gates remain necessary.
